Headline: #65 Grand Temporary Westbound Reroute near Grand/California
ShortDescription: Westbound 65 Grand buses are temporarily rerouted due to construction near Grand/California.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Westbound #65 Grand buses are temporarily rerouted via Grand, California. Chicago, Grand and over the regular route, due to construction near Grand/California.

Eastbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Cottage Grove-bound Green Line Service Delayed
ShortDescription:
Cottage Grove-bound Green Line trains are experiencing delays.

Crews are working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Cottage Grove-bound Green Line trains are experiencing delays.

We are running as much service as possible with available staff.

As a result, Ashland trains are operating around the Loop to 63rd Ashland. 

For service to Cottage Grove, alight Ashland/63rd-bound trains at Garfield; and board a shuttle to Cottage Grove on the Harlem-bound platform at Garfield.

See station personnel for further assistance, and pay attention to announcements on trains and at stations for service information.

We are working to restore service as quickly as possible. Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #119 Michigan/119th Temporary Reroute near 119th/Morgan
ShortDescription: 119 Michigan/119th buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to street blockage near 119th/Morgan.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#119 Michigan/119th buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to street blockage near 119th/Morgan.

Southbound buses will operate via 119th, Ashland, 115th, Vincennes, 119th, over normal route.

Northbound buses will operate via 119th, Vincennes, 115th, Marshfield, 119th, over normal route.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Howard-bound Red Line Service Delayed at Loyola
ShortDescription: Howard-bound Red Line trains are standing near Loyola while we assist a sick passenger. Crews working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Howard-bound Red Line trains are standing near Loyola while we assist a sick passenger. 

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

Personnel are working to restore service. Allow extra travel time.
